description: Required release capability gates for the 4.0.30 System Health Report.

gates.expected: Direct graph reads require named projects and named multi-project results retain project/surface/relation labels.
A non-project session resolves only to Personal general at the MCP boundary.
Recall returns semantic memories, graph facts, entity expansion, timeline, contradictions, and follow-up identifiers.
The fixed recall matrix returns the expected project-scoped semantic evidence for every query category.
Entity expansion and graph facts connect the requested multi-hop project context.
Top-k duplicate occupancy is measured and reported without automatic deduplication.
Similar-name distractors and unrelated facts are measured for recall noise without crossing the named project boundary.
A similarly named cross-project distractor cannot appear in a named-project recall.
Recall distinguishes current facts from timeline and contradiction/supersession history.
Memory add and update reach a stamped graph provenance state without a stale-version orphan.
Authorised non-primary deletion removes derived vector/episode/facts after lifecycle convergence.
Agent primary deletion is rejected; authorised dashboard deletion requires current impact confirmation.
The retired verification control and score-driven archival path cannot act as a hidden trust or deletion bypass.
The Graph V2 rebuild validates, resumes safely, and removes legacy state only after validation.
Graphiti usage headers persist correlated GraphUsageEvent telemetry without losing camel-case fields.
Own-team primary, mounted-team additional, unmounted exclusion, and cross-team write denial remain enforced.
DLP and structural/injection write gates reject unsafe content and keep alerts redacted.
Document evidence, chunks, vector search, provenance, and deletion obey the storage access boundary.
The current worker catalog and lifecycle retry/reconciliation schedules are registered and authorized correctly.
Worker cadence descriptions and schedule editor minute selections render the configured schedule without implying a one-minute run frequency.
The selected release version remains fixed through update hops and progress observation is safe and recoverable.
Candidate typecheck, tests, Graphiti cascade, upgrade validation, documentation build, and navigation checks pass.
The generated report renders correctly at wide and narrow widths in the real Chrome extension session.
Automated factual-truth validation is deliberately deferred; provenance and confidence are not truth certification.
The isolated harness removes its credentials, containers, volumes, and derived state after the run.
